name: pronoun_gender
description: Choose the gendered subject pronoun referring back to a named person (e.g. 'Mary was tired, so' -> ' she'). Control: same sentences, answer is the name repeated ('Mary was tired, so Mary rested. Who rested? Answer:' -> ' Mary').
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
M=['John','David','Michael','James','Robert','Peter','Thomas','Paul','Mark','George','Daniel','Kevin']
F=['Mary','Sarah','Emma','Linda','Susan','Lisa','Anna','Laura','Emily','Jessica','Rachel','Alice']
S=[('was tired, so','rested'),('was hungry, so','ate'),('was late, so','ran'),('felt cold, so','left'),('was bored, so','slept'),('lost the keys, so','waited')]
items=[];ctrl=[]
for n in M+F:
    p=' he' if n in M else ' she'
    for a,b in random.sample(S,4):
        items.append({'prompt':f'{n} {a}','answer':p})
        ctrl.append({'prompt':f'{n} {a} {n} {b}. Who {b}? Answer:','answer':' '+n})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':ctrl},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
